package validationclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestClientUsesInternalAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/api/v1/validate" || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "validation-token" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: path=%q token=%q", request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(domain.ValidationRunResult{ContractKind: "validation", ContractVersion: 1, Passed: true})
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "validation-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.Validate(context.Background(), domain.ValidationRunRequest{TaskID: "task", Mode: "final", CodeStructure: []byte(`{}`)})
	if err != nil || !result.Passed {
		t.Fatalf("result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}
